identity.name: Greensighter AI Designer
identity.summary: Assign design tickets in Jira, Linear, Asana or ClickUp and get designs in your Figma in 24–48 hours, with a human reviewer in the loop.

primaryJob.actor: Product teams or UX/UI designers using Jira, Linear, Asana, or ClickUp
primaryJob.problem: Need to quickly generate consistent, high-quality UI/UX design screens that fit their existing design system
primaryJob.outcome: Receive senior-level quality designs in Figma reviewed by a human designer within 24–48 hours
